name: Agent Monitor
description: Monitors AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, Aider, Archer). Attaches to a shared agent-watcher daemon when tmux-agent-state is present, otherwise starts one; process scan covers agents outside tmux.

claudeHooks.description: Registers Claude Code lifecycle hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, PermissionRequest, Stop) for granular status tracking

notificationEvents.title: Agent needs input
notificationEvents.description: When an agent pauses to ask you a question

notificationEvents.title: Agent finished
notificationEvents.description: When an agent completes a task successfully

notificationEvents.title: Agent failed
notificationEvents.description: When an agent exits with an error

settings.label: Process scan interval (seconds)
settings.help: How often to scan for agent processes not already reported by agent-watcher.

settings.label: Use agent-watcher
settings.help: Attach to tmux-agent-state / Sessh agent-watcher when present, or start the vendored classifier. Requires Python 3.10+ only when this plugin starts the daemon.

settings.label: Python for agent-watcher
settings.help: Interpreter used only when smuler starts the agent-watcher daemon (tmux present, no live socket).
